## Biography

Chansu Han received the B.E. degree in computer science and the M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in informatics engineering from Kyushu University, Fukuoka, Japan, in 2016, 2018, and 2021, respectively. He joined the Cybersecurity Laboratory, National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT), Tokyo, Japan, in 2018. Since 2025, he has been a Researcher with the Center for Research on AI Security and Technology Evolution (CREATE), NICT. He has been a Visiting Assistant Professor with Kyushu University since 2023. His research interests include cybersecurity and AI security, including large language model safety, anomaly detection, and network and malware analysis.
